Spring 2027

Payment due date is based on when you register, see Bursar's payment schedule.  

Important Dates and Deadlines

2026

  

Mon, Oct. 19
  • Enrollment appointments viewable on MySJSU after 9:00 a.m. for continuing students and new graduate students
  • Class schedule available on MySJSU and SJSU Class Schedule page

Tue, Oct. 27 - Mon, Feb. 22
  • Registration period for continuing students 
  • Waitlist begins
  • Enrollment limits
    • Undergrads: Start with 17 units
    • Graduates: Max 16 units per semester

Wed, Nov. 11

Veterans Day - campus closed

Tue, Nov. 17

Automated waitlist reprioritization & variable waitlist unit limit begin

Thu, Nov. 26- Fri, Nov. 27

Thanksgiving holiday - campus closed

Fri, Dec. 25

Christmas holiday - campus closed

Fri, Dec. 25 - Fri, Jan. 22

Winter recess

Fri, Dec. 25

Enrollment limit increased to 19 units for graduating seniors who filed by Oct. 9, 2026

2027

 

Fri, Jan. 1

New Year's Day- campus closed

Wed, Jan. 6
  • First time repeaters may enroll beginning 9 a.m. in MySJSU
  • Processing begins for excess units petitions and repeat exception petitions

Tue, Jan. 12

Enrollment limit increases to 19 units for continuing undergraduate students in good standing

The graduate student enrollment limit remains at 16 units

Mon, Jan. 18

Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. Day -- campus closed

Tue, Jan. 26

 Last day to drop classes and receive a 100% refund

Wed, Jan. 27
  • First day of instruction
  • Waitlist opt-out courses will require permission numbers

Fri, Feb. 5

Waitlist ends

Sat, Feb. 6

Permission numbers required to add classes

Mon, Feb. 22
  • Last day to drop classes without a "W" grade
  • Last day to add/ drop classes in MySJSU
  • Last day to submit Audit or Credit/No-Credit Option Request 
  • Last day to file Excess Units Petition
  • Last day to submit instructor drops

Tue, Feb. 23

Enrollment Census Date -- adding and dropping classes not permitted

Wed, Feb. 24
  • Late Add Post Census Request required to add a class
  • Late Drop or Semester Withdrawal Petition required: Undergraduate | Graduate

Sat, Mar. 20

Graduation application deadline for undergraduate students to qualify for priority registration

Mon, March 29 - Fri, April 2

Spring Recess -- no classes

Wed, March 31

Farmworkers Day - campus closed

Mon, April 19
  • Last day to file a Late Drop or Semester Withdrawal Petition: Undergraduate | Graduate
  • Last day to submit Late Enrollment Post-Census Request

Mon, May 17

Last day of instruction

Tue, May 18

Faculty Web Access for grade posting opens at 8 a.m.

Wed, May 19 - Wed, May 26

 Culminating activities & final examination period

Wed, May 26 - Fri, May 28

 Commencement

Fri, May 28

Grades due from faculty

Sat, May 29

Grades viewable in MySJSU

Mon, May 31

Memorial Day -- campus closed

Fri, June 4

Final deadline for grade submission at 11:59 p.m.

Tue, June 15

Grades finalized: academic standing & spring semester grades posted in MySJSU & transcripts

Fri, June 18

Juneteenth -- campus closed
